component.name: MovieCat
component.summary: Your movie and TV file library

description.p: MovieCat scans your folders for movie and TV files, recognises each title from its file name, and shows the poster, rating, year and a short summary. No account, sign-up or API key needed.

ul.li: Understands messy release names, folder layouts, TV episodes and foreign titles
Finds the folders that hold your movies and shows automatically
Leaves out home videos, screen recordings and tutorials
Rate titles yourself, search, filter and sort
Fix a wrong match in seconds; play a file or show it in its folder with one click

screenshot.caption: The library with posters and ratings

description.p: Sort by date modified, and move movies and episodes to the Trash from the details view.
